title: Dihydroartemisinin responses in a PfMYST perturbation context: a single-cell descriptive brief
question: Which DHA-associated transcript patterns agree across time and glucosamine strata, and what evidence would establish PfMYST dependence?

claims.text: GSE246115 includes Pfmyst-ty1-glmS parasite samples with and without glucosamine and with matched DHA-treated and untreated groups at 6 and 9 hours.
claims.limitation: G0 and G1 are glucosamine strata in one genetic background; this dataset alone does not isolate a PfMYST-specific interaction.

claims.text: The checksum-pinned PfMYST subset contains 5,720 gene rows and 78,262 single-cell columns across ten GEO sample groups.
claims.limitation: Each group corresponds to one GEO sample/library, not thousands of independent biological replicates.

claims.text: The four time-matched DHA/control pseudobulk comparisons have median descriptive log2(CPM+1) ratios from -0.016 to -0.229 among genes with control CPM at least one.
claims.limitation: One library per condition prevents replicate-aware differential-expression inference.

claims.text: Across 3,069 genes meeting the expression filter in all four controls, the four DHA-response rank lists have pairwise Spearman correlations from 0.814 to 0.917.
claims.limitation: The comparisons share a study, processing pipeline, and parasite background; rank agreement is not independent reproduction or proof of pathway specificity.

claims.text: The primary study reports PfMYST knockdown, DHA survival, and multi-omics findings beyond the single-cell count matrix analyzed here.
claims.limitation: Those functional findings were not independently reproduced by this notebook.

claims.text: Use independent parasite cultures at each glucosamine-by-DHA-by-time condition, verify PfMYST knockdown and stage balance, and fit a replicate-aware interaction model before attributing treatment-response differences to PfMYST.
claims.limitation: This follow-up experiment has not been performed.
